title: Beehive message
description: The envelope exchanged between modules and across the cloud-edge channel. Described in its wire form; the in-process form carries one extra header field.

id.description: Message identity, a UUID assigned by the sender. Wire key: ID; JSON key in the in-process form: msg_id.

parent-id.description: Identity of the message this one answers. Set only on a reply. Wire key: ParentID.

timestamp.description: Send time in milliseconds since the epoch, as a signed integer.

sync.description: The sender expects a correlated reply. Absent or false on the great majority of traffic.

message-type.description: Free label set by the sending module. Wire key: MessageType.

resource-version.description: Kubernetes resource version the message is about. Present in the in-process form only: the wire header has no field for it.

route.description: Who sent it, who should get it, and what it is about. The wire form of this object carries source, group, operation and resource; destination is in-process only.

group.description: The module group that should receive it — resource, twin, func, user or taskmanager on the edge side. This is what the receiving hub dispatches on.

operation.description: What to do with the resource: insert, delete, query, update, patch, upload, response, error, unhold-upgrade.

resource.description: Slash-joined path naming what the message is about — node, namespace, resource type, name. Spelled Resouce in the protobuf description, a typo preserved because renaming it would break the wire.

content.description: The payload. Opaque bytes on the wire and an untyped value in process; its shape is inferred by the receiver from route.resource and route.operation. Capped at 32 MiB since v1.23.1.
